_about: Map definitions exported from web v22.5 by tools/export_maps.js. "#hex" = exact 64-bit value.

dawgs.name: Dawgs
dawgs.desc: The original island. A cape, a central airfield and a smugglers’ coast. Best for free-for-all.

twinreach.name: Twin Reach
twinreach.desc: A larger map: two mirrored coasts, a contested central island and long causeways. Built for team battles.

tutorial.name: Training Grounds
tutorial.desc: A small training island with four forts.

brine.name: Brine Archipelago
brine.desc: Five frozen islands strung together by narrow causeways, ringed by glaciers and drifting ice. Every crossing is a chokepoint.

thorn.name: Thornridge
thorn.desc: One rugged, snowbound island ribbed with mountain spurs and edged by glaciers. Fights funnel through the passes.

delta.name: Silverdelta
delta.desc: A river splits the land in two. Three bridges decide everything.

coral.name: Coral Ring
coral.desc: An atoll around a lagoon, with a fortified isle at its heart.

fang.name: Long Fang
fang.desc: A long, winding spit of desert studded with cactus. Fronts move east and west along it.

ember.name: Ember Isles
ember.desc: Four sun-baked desert islands in a loop. Flank around, or punch across the middle.

crown.name: Crown of Eight
crown.desc: The large map: eight home islands ring an inland sea around a fortified central island.
